explanation:
Implement only secure from the acknowledged frame-192 open-gripper stop. The completed alignment and 96-step descent are preserved; the method never restarts acquisition, repeats the near-stalled descent, opens the fingers, transfers or releases. It abandons the old commanded pose as an acceptance criterion, not the safety margins. Fresh current top/table depths and one visible transverse side-boundary relation determine whether the actual pose already supports closure. Full historical corners are unnecessary. The table guard remains 2 mm plus twice current uncertainty, and side overlap remains 3 mm plus twice uncertainty, with an additional 0.5 mm holding reserve. Uncertainty retains the 1 mm working floor and incorporates calibrated pixel scale and measured plane residuals. Failed measurements get one bounded alternative using other patches or the other camera; failed numerical margins are reported without silently relaxing them.

If the actual pose passes, four bounded three-step close holds request zero pose change. Actual hand motion is checked against the directional gap, overlap and centering reserves after each hold. A fresh postclosure review must support an upward-only test, not claim retention. The existing same-carton patch is optional: two independently identified current printed landmarks can replace it. One measured 55-75 mm vertical test then compares surface motion with the actual full hand motion through geo.attachment_error. Stage completion requires adequate effect-to-uncertainty margin, same-carton identity and fresh visible table separation. Reaching the old descent target or the exact lift target is neither substituted for these effects nor required when the actual bounded lift already establishes them. Missing evidence, mismatches and inadequate motion preserve the actual grasp state for supervision.
interface:
Complete Python main(api), using only the documented API and np, math and geo globals. Returns a JSON-compatible object with stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. It validates the acknowledged entry before acting. stage_complete requires fresh differential retention and visible separation evidence; other outcomes are blocked, needs_replan or abort. No yield is returned merely for a host control-slice boundary.

Existing secure.measurements, secure.progress, secure.geometry, secure.observations and secure.tracker are preserved. secure.local stores current measurements, bounded failed alternatives, boundary-ray provenance, fit residuals and actual-pose margins. secure.resume stores prior acknowledged actions, every closure receipt, before/after whole-lift states, the lift receipt and terminal state. secure.baseline stores postclosure landmark identities/depths, actual hand state and optional tracker reference transform. secure.effect stores fresh post-test measurements and visual interpretation. secure.retention stores the measured object/hand comparison and acceptance thresholds. Checkpoint receipts add method, frame and source provenance. Handoff stays compact, identifies these keys and assumptions, distinguishes current and historical bowl references, supplies current visible package extent and gripper state, and contains no later-stage control code. Coordinates are world metres, rotation components radians, quaternions tool-to-world xyzw, and pixels retain camera/frame IDs.
jev_protocol:
Exactly seven control questions are defined. x, y and z explicitly bind to their own state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation for world translation. rx, ry and rz bind to the respective world rotation-vector component. negative means decrease, positive means increase, and hold means within the declared tolerance. The gripper question binds explicitly to state.processed_features.objective.gripper: open, close and keep mean the requested actuation, not an observed grasp. No opening is requested in this method. Every physical command passes through api.control or api.drive and real Jev; answers are dispatched unchanged.

Jev receives trusted current proprioception, residuals and axis relations plus source-labelled numerical program features. Closure features include the measured gap, overlap, width, aperture proxy, centering, uncertainty, geometric frame and hold index; these are preclosure model data, not live contact feedback. Lift features identify the baseline frame, requested rise, uncertainty and the still-unverified retention objective. Python calculates geometry with the supplied helpers. GPT reviews identify visible surfaces, printed landmarks, boundary membership, local lane and table separation using declared fields. The method checks named-measurement membership, errors and frame consistency before geometry. Jev is not asked to calculate metrics, see images, infer hidden state or certify retention.

Closure consists of at most four three-step controls targeting each measured current TCP pose with 0.5 mm position tolerance, 0.01 rad rotation tolerance and no requested pose change. Conservative observed hand-envelope motion is projected onto the measured top/table normals to check consumption of each directional geometric reserve; lateral centering is also rechecked. Any non-hold axis choice, gripper mismatch, stall or consumed guard stops without retrying or reopening. Fresh postclosure evidence then validates the changed configuration. The only ordinary motion is one api.drive vertical-test lease, at most 26 calls and capped by remaining resources, with 8 mm translation limit, 0.02 rad rotation limit, three steps per decision, 1.5 mm position tolerance and 0.01 rad rotation tolerance. Host slice pauses may resume the same stack; no additional lease is used to push through a stop.

The optional persistent tracker must match its saved physical identity/reference frame and return current registration with at least 12 inliers, fraction at least 0.65, RMS at most 2.5 mm and planar feature spread exceeding three times its residual/noise floor. Independently identified landmarks are an obtainable replacement; their separation must exceed four times their uncertainty. There is no absolute patch-size gate. Unknown tracking is never extrapolated and is not repeatedly queried without motion. The test rise is max(55 mm, 30 times baseline uncertainty), no more than the observed 75 mm lane. Whole-lift states are saved rather than interpreting the last drive receipt as total motion. Acceptance requires at least 40 mm actual hand rise, 35 mm observed surface rise, actual travel greater than eight times combined uncertainty, and attachment discrepancy within max(5 mm, three times combined uncertainty), itself at most one quarter of actual travel. Fresh same-carton identity and visible separation are mandatory. Closure, tracking, a reached pose or elapsed control slices alone cannot establish the stage effect, and completion_proposed always remains false.
